periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation with the superior pole positioned laterally and the inferior pole positioned medially.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering toward the rostrum, extending below the horizontal eye line.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distinct gap between the medial edges of the dark ear regions relative to total cranial width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior margins.
